title: Great Zimbabwe Stone Enigma

scenes.text: Thousands of stone walls rise without mortar
The ruins sit on a hilltop near the town of Masvingo in southeastern Zimbabwe.
Construction dates to the 11th–15th centuries, using precisely cut granite blocks.
